causalAutopsy.notes: Not a code regression. The tone-reaction flags shipped with the advisory migration but were documented nowhere agent-facing, while the agent template mandates the relay script and documents only the HTTP metadata shape — so the invocation had to be invented. The parse loop then swallowed a misplaced flag into MSG=$* and sent it as message text, exit 0. Two silent layers: an undocumented capability, and a tool permissive about the only usage an uninstructed caller would try. Detected only because the swallowed flags produced a downstream verdict absurd enough to investigate — and that investigation itself mis-graded a correct check.
